This unit cannot be sold.

==Trivia==
Idol (Star) has the ability to lower the cost of upgrading your units and also give a Damage Boost to any of your units you place '''no matter where she is''' placed on the map.
* This cannot stack with [[Blossom]] buffs.
* This buff stacks additionally with [[Commander]], [[Wind Dragon]] and [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]]'s buffs
* Note that her normal version isn't even limited. She's the first unit to do so.
* She is the first unit to have her banner version after debuting as a battlepass unit.
* During Update 12.5.0, she had issues with [[Trickster (Release)]].
* As of Update 15, she, [[Blossom]], [[Skeleton (Soul King)]] and [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]] are the only ones capable of buffing both Physical and Magical damage.
** She's the only one who can only affect the user's own units.
*From update 19.5, she can negate High Cost debuffs, which is not affected by High Cost stages and reduced the placement cost of other units to normal state.
* This is the first unit to be able to reduce upgrade costs, making her very useful for High Cost stages.
* Golden trait has cost reduction of 6% at deployment, 12% at upgrade 1, 18% at upgrade 2, 24% at upgrade 3.

* This is the first unit to have 2 shiny variants, one from the cake hunt battlepass and one from the banner
